messages:
ryan: quick heads-up: onboarding NimbusLite-6B-int4 shows OOMs when max_new_tokens > 700 under steady traffic. observed fragmentation spikes during warmup. anyone digging in?
sophia: saw those logs. repro with 20rps mixed-lengths, slab free_list fragmentation jumps to ~0.7 then alloc failures for ~80MB chunks.
dev-bot: incident INC-9981 filed for nimbus-canary-2.
tara: initial mitigation idea: reduce default max_new to 512, disable eager KV prefetch for this model, and bump microbatch timeout to 100ms. tradeoffs: slightly higher p50 latency. recommend small canary run.
ryan: ok run matrix?
sophia: matrix: (1) max_new=512 prefetch=off microbatch=100ms, (2) max_new=800 prefetch=lazy microbatch=60ms, (3) baseline max_new=1200 prefetch=on microbatch=40ms.
ryan: quick smoke after 30m: (1) zero OOMs, p99 +10% (2) 1 OOM, fragmentation reduced slightly (3) 3 OOMs.
tara: eval-bot: quality check for (1) vs baseline float32: perp +0.25, qa acc -0.4% (within noise).
sophia: suggest landing default change to 512 for canary only, add telemetry tag model.reason=frag_warmup and session.len_bucket. tara: opening PR with config + rollout plan (canary=2, watch 24h). ryan: add note to ops playbook about slab-compaction as a last resort.
ryan: done, thanks team :thumbsup:
